inputMeaning: Only the existing full Russian02 Assembly-CSharp.dll, or the byte-identical normal builder stage after existing gallery/item/quest/inventory/chapter patches, is patchable. Original DLL is read-only source/evaluation evidence.

boundary.displayGetter: ResponseOption.get_text returns backing string unchanged; SetText stores its exact argument and mirrors it to selected/enabled native/TMP labels. SetHaikuLine1/2/3 send their exact argument to TMP_Text.set_text. No trim is present at these boundaries.
boundary.runtimeIdentity: This runtime exposes display text at the consumer. The exact Russian label plus original slot and pinned conversation/finish context uniquely selects the original stable choice ID and full source line. No screen-order assumption and no global string rewrite.
boundary.contextBinding: The validated original ExecuteTrigger body reaches the nine patched calls only inside the date2 haiku finish trigger, after all original mode guards. Each slot-specific private getter supplies its original field, slot, and the fixed source context to Resolve. No caller outside that boundary is added. The context is a statically verified call-site contract, not a newly observed native scene assertion.
boundary.caseAndTrim: Exact ordinal label equality, no normalization/trim. Original parameterless ToLower and Contains calls remain byte-position stable and preserve current-culture behavior.
boundary.failClosed: First slot getter checks all three slot maps before the first comparison, so short-circuiting cannot hide missing/unknown lines. Wrong context, unknown slot, changed case/whitespace or a non-mapped label throws InvalidOperationException. No source/English display fallback.
boundary.controlPreserved: All existing method definitions, fields, branch instruction widths/offsets/targets, locals, handlers, producers, callbacks, trigger/arc keys, audio and one-second continuation remain unchanged outside the nine exact 5-byte ldsfld -> call replacements.

reversibility.action: Restore the nine original field-load instructions and remove only the four appended helper methods; serialize and compare against the entire prior DLL.
reversibility.result: Exact whole payload SHA-256 matches Russian02; saved before.dll and actual reversed.dll both verify.
reversibility.boundary: The builder copies only a fully verified staged DLL into its isolated new output. Backend writes prior DLL, patched DLL, reversed DLL, method ledger and receipt separately; not a multi-file transaction. An injected filesystem failure after payload writes leaves no completion receipt and rejects reuse of occupied paths. No writes touch the existing candidate or original.

normalBuilder.preflight: Before creating output; exact input/peer/194/27/mapping pins
normalBuilder.snapshot: Every later-read adapter source, original DLL/Cecil dependency and source/target/peer receipt is copied under the new output haiku-identity/. Late compilation and patching use only this snapshot.
normalBuilder.actualProof: A separately compiled frozen snapshot reproduces the accepted patched DLL byte for byte. Full game builder was not run.

remaining.sixTemplateFields: Retained as explicitly bound source dependencies, untouched by this assembly-only identity adapter; full scene/template display acceptance remains with parent.
remaining.nextAction: Parent integrates the verified code and, under its applicable runtime instruction, binds all27 fixture contracts to the existing isolated real-game harness; checks actual selected labels, stable callbacks, field/display lines, trigger/arc priority and one-second continuation.
